headline: CIN @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 3.34 at PHI 4.78, with a projected total of 8.12. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: CIN moved -0.67 runs while PHI moved -1.03, changing the projected margin by +0.37 runs. The projected total fell -1.70, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +9.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Chase Burns has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Spencer Steer, Elly De La Cruz, Kyle Schwarber, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adolis García, Will Benson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
